headline: Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row Lead Renewed Strongpoint Fighting
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, the strongest point-fighting has shifted to Fisherman's Row and Stlican Shelf. Fisherman's Row, quieter in the previous closing returns, now logs six events in the latest two-hour sheet and thirty-six over the past day; Eidolo and Black Well led its contested strongpoints. Stlican Shelf, idle in the last report, has likewise broken that quiet with eight events in the final two hours and thirty-three in the daily ledger, chiefly around Pale House and Vulpine Watch. Weathered Expanse has also stirred again, posting two events after a quiet stretch, while Mooring County continues at a slower pace with three. By contrast, LinnMercy and Stonecradle—prominent in the last edition—show no closing-window events, although their six-hour totals remain substantial. Farranac Coast and Godcrofts recorded fresh closing action (three and six events, respectively); Callahan's Passage has added nothing since midday. Casualty returns stay heavy around Stonecradle, Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse. Neither side yet holds the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest.
